package.description: Peer-to-peer pet monitoring, no subscription required for live monitoring

en-US.description: Peer-to-peer pet monitoring, no subscription required for live monitoring
en-US.longDescription: SeeBoop turns a phone or an old PC into a pet camera. One device acts as a Station near your pet, another as a Viewer so you can watch and talk back from anywhere. Video and audio stream directly between your own devices over WebRTC, live monitoring is free with no subscription, and Premium unlocks recordings, multi-Station support, scheduling, and AI sound detection (bark, meow, crash).
en-US.name: SeeBoop
